originality.rationale: The full 1998 Wang–Shallit paper provides a shortest noncyclic linear word and at least one construction, and explicitly leaves enumeration of minimal linear words open; no complete 2352/42 census of shortest cyclic covers is given. Moreno (2003) and Moreno–Matamala (2007) count or construct exact-once cycles for periodically legal factors rather than all linear target factors; at n=3 their periodic language excludes 101. Two alternative exact enumerations independently establish the new small-order class counts. Relevant semantic and exact-phrase searches did not reveal prior coverage; unindexed enumerations remain a risk.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed exact enumeration or published table could cover the 2352/42 claim despite searches.
The full text of Moreno (2005) remained inaccessible; cannot exclude an unreported classification in that paper.
Wang–Shallit (1998) is close foundational prior, and later enumerative corollaries could exist; the new claim explicitly excludes their known length theorem.

value.rationale: Complete small-order classification for a natural golden-mean universal cyclic-cover invariant, especially 42 distinct nonreflection-symmetric optimal order-six designs and their complete catalogue. Covers all linearly admissible six-blocks, unlike restricted de Bruijn cycles, and distinguishes multiplicity of designs beyond a known minimum-length/existence theorem. Gives precise all-seven-distinct repetitions in every optimizer; no arbitrary unmotivated slice or unproved asymptotic extrapolation.
